'''Grol'dom Farm''' {{coords|56|20|Barrens}} is one of the many [[orcish]] [[pig farm]]s that have sprung up in the years after the founding of [[Orgrimmar]]. It is inhabited by [[Kranal Fiss]], a farmer who also has a mission to offer to [[shaman]]s seeking the totem of fire. In addition to Kranal, there are a few small orcish children present.
